theses.subject: Oil & Gas Producers
theses.thesis: Oil & Gas is the clear momentum leader with high breadth (0.929) and trend-gate eligibility, suggesting leadership concentration. Crowding (z=1.18) and one-narrative=false indicate this is not a single-story blowoff, so continuation is possible, but the mixed Hurst tag and crowding caution cap conviction.

theses.subject: Big Banks
theses.thesis: Big Banks show the strongest trend structure of the top ranks (hurst=trend, durability 0.71, breadth 0.857) and are NOT crowded, making them a relatively cleaner trend expression than the crowded Energy leader. As the challenger in rotation, they offer lower drawdown-trigger risk than the crowded leader.
theses.dissent: Banks are a high-beta expression of the Canadian macro cycle; any housing-led credit deterioration or BoC tightening surprise would hit them first, and the rotational margin to Oil & Gas remains wide.

theses.subject: Utilities & Renewables
theses.thesis: Utilities rank mid-pack but show the strongest trend-health read of all eligible themes (hurst=trend, durability 0.78) with low crowding (z=-0.47) and adequate breadth (0.75). The detector's trend-gate leg — the only validated edge — is most favorable here among non-crowded themes, making it a drawdown-controlled trend lean.
theses.dissent: Utilities are highly rate-sensitive in Canada; if rates stay elevated longer than the market expects, the rate-driven discounting pressure could overwhelm the price-trend signal regardless of trend-health readings.

falsifier.text: XUT.TO underperforms the S&P/TSX by over 5% while the benchmark is flat or rising
